t.19.2: Taking up the pincers of the knowledge of truth, I have drawn out from the depths of my heart the thorn of manifold opinions.
t.19.3: Where is duty, where is pleasure, where is wealth, and where is discernment? Where is duality, and where even non-duality, for me who abide in my own greatness?
t.19.4: Where is the past, where the future, or even the present? Where is space, and where even the eternal, for me who abide in my own glory?
t.19.5: For me, abiding in my own glory, where is the Self and where the not-Self, where is good and where is evil, where is thought and where is the absence of thought?
t.19.6: Where is dreaming, where is deep sleep, and where too is waking? Where is the fourth state, or even fear, for me who abide in my own greatness?
t.19.7: Where is far, or where is near; where is outside, or where is inside; where is gross, and where is subtle, for me who abides in my own greatness?
t.19.9: Enough of talk about the three aims of life, enough too of talk about yoga, enough of talk about knowledge, for me who rest in the Self.
t.19.8: Where is death, or where is life? Where are the worlds, and where for such a one is worldly concern? Where is dissolution, or where is meditative absorption, for me who abide in my own glory?
